author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at how the most recent update to GTA has shown just how greedy Rockstar has become. I've played GTA 5 since the beginning and the latest update should have been a swan song before the next game but instead it's an update where Rockstar has forced players to grind multitudes more in the hopes we spend money on pointless microtransactions. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
